mapper.insert: insert into attachment (note_id, user_id, original_file_name, stored_file_name, content_type, file_size, file_path, created_at) values (#{noteId}, #{userId}, #{originalFileName}, #{storedFileName}, #{contentType}, #{fileSize}, #{filePath}, now())
mapper.select: select attachment_id, note_id, user_id, original_file_name, stored_file_name, content_type, file_size, file_path, created_at from attachment where note_id = #{noteId} and user_id = #{userId} order by created_at desc

select attachment_id, note_id, user_id, original_file_name, stored_file_name, content_type, file_size, file_path, created_at from attachment where attachment_id = #{attachmentId} and user_id = #{userId}
